skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge of economic management to analyze organizational decisions and clarify management situations in a market economy.
Apply knowledge of organizational management to solve problems within the organization.
Apply knowledge of government economic management to analyze and summarize issues in organizational and governmental management.
Develop systematic thinking and communication skills.
Develop skills in analyzing organizations and managing them effectively.
Develop skills in managing the economy from a governmental perspective.
Demonstrate independent work skills and manage resources and performance effectively.
Proactively fulfill social responsibility and professional ethics.
Demonstrate self-learning abilities and adaptability to change.
